description: Evidence-specific Time-To-Live (TTL) and freshness guardrails for SabiScore V21 feature families. Universal 72-hour fallback is prohibited.

live_ratings.ttl_rationale: Dynamic Elo ratings update on match settlement; stale beyond 1 hour when matchdays are in flight.

team_form.ttl_rationale: Form reflects the last 5 competitive fixtures over a rolling 14-day window; invalid if older than 14 days without an active season context.

standings.ttl_rationale: League tables update per matchday tick; 24-hour TTL guarantees table points, goal difference, and positions reflect the latest matchday.

injuries.ttl_rationale: Injury reports require fresh verification within 4 hours of matchday build.

lineups.ttl_rationale: Official team sheets are released 60-75 minutes before kickoff; provisional lineups expire at T-75m.

player_status.ttl_rationale: Suspensions and squad availability must be verified within 6 hours of kickoff.

league_context.ttl_rationale: League-wide baseline averages (goals/game, draw rate, home advantage) are season-scale statistics valid for 7 days.

market_prices.ttl_rationale: Live 1X2 market quotes fluctuate continuously; any price snapshot older than 300 seconds (5 minutes) is considered stale for execution.
